description: Edit a form's draft with a list of operations (add/update/remove/move questions, set title/theme/layout). All-or-nothing; returns the updated form and validation issues. Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

form_id.description: Form id — from list_forms or create_form.

operations.description: Applied in order, all-or-nothing. Each item is one of: {"op":"add_question","question":{...same shape as create_form questions},"after":"<blockId>|null"}, {"op":"update_question","blockId","title?","description?","required?","options?":[...]}, {"op":"remove_question","blockId","force?"}, {"op":"move_question","blockId","after":"<blockId>|null"}, {"op":"set","title?","description?","theme?":"minimal|paper|midnight|pastel|brutalist|glass|editorial|terminal|neon|nature|corporate|playful|monochrome|sunset|ocean|academic|luxury|default","layout?":"classic|one_at_a_time|conversation"}. Changes go to the draft; call publish_form to make them live.

name: update_form
